conventions.convention: The complex L² inner product is linear in its first variable. Magnetic forms initially have domain C_c^∞, with real smooth A and real locally integrable V bounded below.

SI minimal coupling is Π = −iℏ∇ − qA. The planar B is ∂xAy − ∂yAx; the three-dimensional field is curl A. Mass, charge, action, A and V use kilograms, coulombs, joule-seconds, tesla-metres and joules.
S¹ = R/(2πZ), its Hilbert-space measure is dφ, and H²_per requires matching endpoint traces of both f and f′.
Partial Fourier transforms use kernel exp(−iky)/√(2π), so −i∂y becomes k. The shear is x = ξ + ℏk/(qB); oscillator indices start at zero and ωc = |qB|/m.
Increasing φ orients the ring, positive flux means circulation Φ in that orientation, and α = qΦ/(2πℏ). Integer flux shifts are implemented by multiplication by exp(ijφ).
The Pauli matrices have σ1σ2 = iσ3 and S = ℏσ/2. The square identity is asserted only on compactly supported smooth spinors, not on closed operator domains.

The form lemmas assume Countable Choice and Dependent Choice; the physical spectral deductions additionally retain full Choice. Physical Hamiltonians use a positive reference energy of 1 J when applying dimensionless form representation.

load_bearing.statement: Assume Countable Choice and Dependent Choice, m,ℏ > 0, and real q,B with qB ≠ 0. The stated partial Fourier and translation map is unitary, and the closure of the planar magnetic core form has exactly domain {u: Σn E_n ||f_n||² < ∞} and value Σn E_n ||f_n||², where E_n = ℏ|qB|(n+1/2)/m.

Assume Countable Choice and Dependent Choice. For smooth real A and real V ∈ L¹_loc with V ≥ −v₀ almost everywhere, the stated magnetic form on C_c^∞ is closable in every stated shifted form norm. Its closure is densely defined, closed, Hermitian and bounded below by −v₀.

Assume Choice, Countable Choice and Dependent Choice. For κ > 0 and real α, Tα = κ(−i∂φ−α)² on H²_per(S¹) is self-adjoint with complete normalized character eigenbasis and eigenvalues κ(n−α)², n ∈ Z. Its spectral measures are purely atomic. Integer shifts of α are unitarily intertwined, and a smooth periodic unit-modulus multiplier removing α exists exactly when α ∈ Z.

Assume Countable Choice and Dependent Choice, m,ℏ > 0 and qB ≠ 0. The stated three-dimensional Fourier, shear and oscillator-coefficient transform is unitary, and the magnetic form closure has exactly domain and value given by Σn ∫(E_n + ℏ²k_z²/(2m))|f_n(k_y,k_z)|² dk_y dk_z < ∞.

Adopt the SI minimal-coupling assignment using the closed magnetic core form and its unique self-adjoint representing Hamiltonian. The optional three-dimensional effective Pauli term is included only when its resulting form is closable and bounded below; no universal semiboundedness or measured g-factor is asserted.

concerns.concern: Proof 3.1 identifies the abstract form completion with the weighted target without explicitly showing that the completion embeds injectively into the original L² space, which is needed for closability. The missing argument is immediate from E_n + ck_z² ≥ E₀ > 0: the weighted space includes continuously and injectively into unweighted coefficient L², so a form-Cauchy core sequence with zero L² limit has zero weighted limit. Step 2.2 also leaves the extension of the core energy identity to its Schwartz cutoff differences implicit; the planar lemma supplies the corresponding argument.

In the Remarks TikZ diagram, the segment labelled R runs from (0.2,0.2) to (1.35,0.85), while the constrained circle is centred at (0,0) with radius 1.5. The labelled segment therefore is not a radius: it starts off-centre and ends outside the circle. The algebraic proof is independent of this schematic.
